name: Data Journalism / Infographic
summary: A single clear chart or map as the hero, drawn in the order of the argument, with one accent for the point and neutrals for context.

identity.editorial_approach: the headline states the finding, the chart proves it

palette.contrast_strategy: neutral context, one accent for the finding

typography.mono: JetBrains Mono for axes and values

composition.principles: chart occupies 60-75% of the frame; annotations attach to data points

motion.grammar: Reveal data in the order of the argument; draw lines, grow bars, then annotate the point.

timing.pace: medium; the narration sets the beat

motion.kinetic_typography: counter rolls to the true value
motion.stillness_policy: Hold on the finished chart long enough to read it.

rendering.strategy: Studio.draw.chart plus SVG; data supplied as JSON for reproducibility.

provenance.method: Authored rule set (prescribed). Derived from the style system's tokens, the workspace motion vocabulary and the technique records listed; not extracted from a single reference.
provenance.notes: Every value here is prescribed intent, not a measurement. Evidence of use is recorded under 'validation' only after a render exists.

weaknesses: Truncated axes or invented values mislead: every number needs a source.
A chart on a dark crisis story can feel cold.
Dashboard cards are the failure mode: keep one chart per frame.
example_scenes: A line chart drawn left to right, with a vermilion marker stopping on the fall and a label counting to the exact value.
